notes_for_editor: Index-only evidence from tnlandforms (GA379). Checked and empty for this tower: Wikipedia Stewart County and Providence Canyon State Park pages, gastateparks.org, the NHLR Georgia list, the FFLOS and FFLA Georgia pages, two web searches. The story is about 72 words, well under the roughly 120-word floor for thin evidence; consider holding it. The index states no unit for elevation. Feet are an inference: the record's metres match 662 ft, and the index's largest values (4735 for GA006) cannot be metres in Georgia. The Tom Dunigan attribution does not appear on the page and was removed. The gfc-314 tag is the index's own tag and has not been checked against Georgia Forestry Commission records. The name 'providence' is the index author's label, not an official name.
